## Change

What concrete problem does this solve, and what behavior or content results?

## Validation

List the checks and affected flows you actually exercised. For UI work, include browser/viewport and a screenshot when useful. Record any checks you could not run and why.

## Data and source scope

If applicable, link the original sources and inspected locations, describe identity/assay/reference changes, and retain draft status and unknowns. State whether numerical results, input privacy or dependencies change.
